You can't make up the way Washington operates. If you speak up against wrongdoing or injustice, you get villainized and attacked.

As the daughter of a retired General and the most decorated alumni of The Citadel in his lifetime, backing down has never been an option. No one will ever stop us from standing up and doing what is right.

No ID, no vote. End of story.

Standing up for our military is not just a priority. It is a promise we have kept since coming to Congress. Here's what we have delivered:

✅ Secured $944.8 MILLION in NDAA authorizations for Lowcountry military installations.

✅ Supported the authorization of more than $30 million for a state-of-the-art VA Community-Based Outpatient Clinic in Beaufort County, bringing primary care, mental health services, and essential VA programs closer to home for nearly 17,000 local veterans.

The United States of America is, and always will be, the greatest country on earth. 

Thanks to the men and women of our armed forces. 
Thanks to our law enforcement and first responders. 
Thanks to our small business owners, farmers, fishermen, doctors, nurses, and teachers. 

You are the backbone of this nation. Our Constitution is worth defending. May God always bless the United States of America. 🇺🇸
If illegal immigrants voted Republican, how fast would the Left be working overtime to deport every single one of them?

South Carolina has always produced warriors. This tradition is alive and well.

We will always stand for our military and the South Carolina National Guardsmen defending our country and our nation's capital, the same way they stand on the front lines for us. 

While Washington plays politics, these men and women are doing the real work. They are the foundation of this country and they deserve to have their commitment matched.

South Carolina is the fastest growing state in the nation and it's no accident.

Conservative leadership delivers results.

No one works harder for the great people of South Carolina.


Gunther Eagleman™ (@GuntherEagleman)

🚨 SOUTH CAROLINA IS BOOMING
 
+59,000 new residents in just one year.

That’s a net gain of over 1% of the entire state population — the highest in the nation.

For every 100 South Carolinians, more than one is a new arrival escaping blue-state madness.

South Carolina has a pothole problem.
South Carolina is the fastest growing state in the country, and it cannot afford to grow on crumbling infrastructure.
We are one nation under GOD.

Our office met with CPT Robert Cornicelli, Founder and President of the Veteran Recovery Coalition.

They use a practical, results-driven approach to help veterans avoid homelessness, return to work or school, stay out of debt, and rebuild their independence, with every dollar coordinated through trusted service providers under strict financial oversight.

No waste. No bureaucracy. Just real, accountable support for the men and women who served this country. The results speak for themselves.

We need to be honest with the American people about what is going on in our elections. Illegals are being allowed to vote. Deceased people are still on voter rolls. Our democracy is being stolen one vote at a time.

We need to dig our heels in here and get the SAVE America Act to the President's desk to be signed into law.

Video

The integrity of our democracy is counting on the SAVE America Act being passed.

The future of our country is counting on the SAVE America Act being passed.

The preservation of our Constitution and our values is counting on the SAVE America Act being passed.

America is counting on the SAVE America Act being passed.

Dorchester County is growing fast. More than 22,000 new residents have chosen to call it home since 2020, a nearly 14% increase in just six years.

With this growth, our infrastructure must keep pace. This is why we supported the county in securing a $24.6 million BUILD grant through the U.S. Department of Transportation to make upgrades to U.S. Highway 78. This investment will improve safety, reduce congestion, and support long-term economic growth.

We commend Dorchester County and its leaders

Today we observe the National Day of Prayer to pray for unity and for our country, the United States of America. We are one nation under GOD.

Psalm 33:12: “Blessed is the nation whose God is the Lord.”
